Detect Array Platform from IDAT Files and Annotate Metadata

Source: R/MethQcSet-io.R
check_platform.Rd

Reads IDAT files for each sample in meta and detects the Illumina array platform by reading probe count from the raw channel data. Appends Platform, Array_Size, Manifest, and Status columns to meta.

Usage

check_platform(meta, max_retries = 5)

Arguments

meta

A data.frame with required column Basename (path prefix to IDAT files, e.g. /path/to/idats/Sentrix_ID). A Sample_Name column is used for messaging; if absent, row numbers are used.

max_retries

Integer. Number of read attempts per sample before marking as "Failed". Default: 5.

Value

meta with four columns appended:

Platform

Detected platform: "EPIC", "EPICv2", "450K", "27K", or NA

Array_Size

Number of probes in the raw IDAT

Manifest

Manifest string from array annotation (may be NA)

Status

"Success" or "Failed"

Details

Use this function before runMethQC() when the platform is unknown or when you need to check whether a cohort spans multiple array types.

Platform is inferred from array size using the same logic as meth_check_platform.R::CheckPlatform():

  • > 1,100,000 probes → "EPICv2"

  • > 1,000,000 probes → "EPIC"

  • > 400,000 probes → "450K"

  • > 20,000 probes → "27K"

If the annotation string disagrees with the array size, the array-size inference is used and a warning is issued.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
meta <- read.table("meta.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
meta_updated <- check_platform(meta)
table(meta_updated$Platform)

# Split by platform before running QC
meta_epic <- meta_updated[meta_updated$Platform == "EPIC", ]
qcset <- runMethQC(meta_epic)
} # }
